scope: Public sources only; reviewed source and host validation. No hardware qualification or installer release.
included: T6030 SIO and HDMI audio support for J514S/J516S, runtime opt-in
14.7 external timing, catalog, drive-level and hotplug recovery
Panel mailbox hold through s2idle with queued notifications preserved
CTM capability gating and J514C board record
Five ABI-neutral correctness fixes on the maintained asahi-m3/g15 driver
excluded: G15 replacement with incompatible render448/compute200 ABI
Already integrated brightness and Naeem/PMP changes
Crossbar power changes with unresolved output race
Experimental memory floor: retained only on a separate local branch, default off

review.verdict: Accepted for source integration at 54add20fd52e; hardware qualification pending.
fixes: Retry transient HDMI service failures until the refusal threshold
Preserve queued callbacks while mailbox receive is held; kick pump on resume
Pair GPU power-hold release with the PMP vote policy
Keep a bounded history of dropped external swaps
Restore audio after an early external modeset failure
Keep external catalog rules off the J613 internal-pipe Type-C path
Initialize audio work disabled before bind enables it
Preserve qualified acknowledgement behavior when the PHY refuses drive levels
Use selected-colour bpp and maximum PHY lanes for external mode budgets
Power down a standby sink after unplug
Serialize kept-on publication and release using a leaf mutex; reject stale cleanup by sink generation
review.message_rewording: Independently verified all 37 old/new mapped commits have identical trees, authors, committers and dates.

validation.warning_scope: No new C warnings; existing Rust dead-code warnings and existing lockdep-build modpost section mismatch remain.
validation.regression_mutations: Runtime regression failures inspected for the review fixes, including look-before-locks and stale sink cleanup; initial compile-only mutations were corrected and rerun.
validation.root_host_reproducer: Extracted production function bodies reproduced the original HDMI retry, floor retry/overflow and kept-on interleaving defects. The final kept-on fix is covered by concurrent KUnit and lockdep.
validation.tested_paths: G15 host checks and broad W=1/DTB validation at 732f8107; final 54add20f changes only display code and its tests, with final display KUnit, lockdep and W=1 rerun.

configuration.hdmi_audio: Runtime opt-in unchanged; no boot parameter added.

hardware_pending: J514S/J516S boot without workqueue warnings; existing brightness, GPU and both displays
Suspend/resume and abort with panel brightness restored
HDMI audio opt-in, hotplug/replug and TV standby/unplug followed by sleep
J613 Type-C modes and existing marker admission
Two-lane USB3 plus DP training, USB4 retraining and 4:2:0-only TV modes
Compositor night-light fallback after CTM capability change
known_limits: A no-op external modeset can bounce an enabled HDMI audio jack.
The fw14 colour fallback ranks YCbCr444 ahead of RGB10; physical display evaluation pending.
USB4 callback20 retraining can produce disconnect/reconnect.
Replacement attach can overlap cleanup power-down while the CRTC is off, as with DPMS off.
Dropped-swap history is bounded to four IDs; no arbitrary-latency completion guarantee.
Existing pre-firmware admit ASC-read error can retain a runtime-PM hold.
release_policy: This source pin does not change signed qualified board reports or installer artifacts. Public v2026.10.18.5 remains on its previously hardware-qualified kernel until a new build and hardware qualification.
